name: DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /ScanHealth
title: Scan the Windows Component Store
summary: Checks whether the running Windows image has repairable component-store corruption.

examples.description: Scans the active Windows image without performing a component-store repair.

permissions.notes: Run from Command Prompt opened as administrator and follow organizational support policy.

risk.warning: ScanHealth is diagnostic but can take several minutes and writes servicing logs and temporary working data. Do not close the terminal while it is running.

output_fields.name: No component store corruption detected
output_fields.description: Windows did not detect component-store corruption.

output_fields.name: The component store is repairable
output_fields.description: Corruption was detected and a separately approved repair may be appropriate.

output_fields.name: The component store cannot be repaired
output_fields.description: Escalation or recovery media may be required.

common_errors.message: The source files could not be found
common_errors.meaning: Windows could not access required servicing content.
